source: GET https://codesamplex.dev/v1/samples/<id> on 2026-08-27, for ids drawn from the public sitemap. Public data only: package URLs, symbol names, the manifest goal and the first contract line.

samples.goal: Tokio broadcast channels require navigating zero-receiver SendError drops, RecvError::Lagged stream recovery without premature loop termination, and late subscription history exclusion
contract: assert broadcast::channel(0) panics because broadcast capacity must be strictly positive

samples.goal: Handle Symfony Console silent verbosity suppressing exception rendering, VALUE_NEGATABLE tri-state and boolean default resolution, ArgvInput greedy optional token capture, ArrayInput argument key prefix isolation, non-interactive Question normalizer skipping, and ChoiceQuestion associative key returns
contract: Running a failing command with --silent (VERBOSITY_SILENT) exits with code 1 but completely suppresses exception rendering, while --quiet (VERBOSITY_QUIET) renders the exception message to error output

samples.goal: ActiveSupport.gem_version returns a Gem::Version instance representing the ActiveSupport version string
contract: ActiveSupport.gem_version returns a Gem::Version instance with version string 8.1.3.1 that supports semantic comparisons and segments decomposition.

samples.goal: verify pkg:golang/github.com/jackc/pgx/v5@v5.10.0
contract: pgx.StrictNamedArgs.RewriteQuery rewrites named parameters into positional parameters and extracts matching arguments

samples.goal: Construct transactional pipelines with Ecto.Multi: handle Ecto 3's two-arity run callback requirement, contrast with one-arity dynamic operation builders, and inspect pipeline stages
contract: assert Ecto.Multi.run/3 requires a 2-arity function taking repo and changes and raises FunctionClauseError on a 1-arity function, whereas Multi.insert/3 and Multi.merge/2 accept 1-arity functions receiving only changes

samples.goal: verify pkg:npm/yaml@2.9.0
contract: Lexer.lex tokenizes mapping keys, values, and delimiters into lexical token streams

samples.goal: Assert that maps of equal length with differing keys and null values are evaluated as unequal under equatable 2.0.8, correcting the false positive in 2.0.7
contract: equatable 2.0.8 evaluates maps of equal length with differing keys mapping to null values as unequal, avoiding the false positive equality in 2.0.7.

samples.goal: Resolve relative URLs strictly per RFC 3986 with URL.join while relying on Client base_url normalization for prefix-preserving path concatenation
contract: httpx.URL.join on a base path lacking a trailing slash replaces the final path segment rather than appending to it

samples.goal: Spawning non-Send futures in Tokio requires driving a LocalSet explicitly, avoiding uncontextualized spawn_local panics and unpolled task starvation
contract: assert tokio::task::spawn_local panics at runtime when called without an active LocalSet context on the current thread

samples.goal: Configure Mustermann pattern options across ignore_unknown_options, space_matches_plus, capture constraints, except exclusions, and pattern type selection without unhandled option ArgumentErrors, anchored regex matching failures, or invalid expand errors
contract: assert Mustermann.new raises ArgumentError on unrecognized router configuration options unless ignore_unknown_options: true is explicitly configured

samples.goal: verify github.com/francoispqt/gojay.Encoder in pkg:golang/github.com/francoispqt/gojay@v1.2.13
contract: gojay.NewEncoder serializes Go structs implementing MarshalerJSONObject with typed field encoding methods including IntKey, StringKey, BoolKey, Float64Key, StringKeyOmitEmpty, and ArrayKey.

samples.goal: Handle silent behavioral changes in lru-cache across version boundaries where set(key, undefined) deletes entries, legacy options are silently ignored, overwrites trigger dispose, and fetch rejection evicts stale data
contract: assert set(key, undefined) silently deletes entry rather than storing undefined value like Map.set

samples.goal: Demonstrate that EquatableConfig.stringify defaults to true in debug mode (assertions enabled) in v2.0.0, enabling property stringification by default.
contract: By default in debug mode (assertions enabled), printing an Equatable instance that does not override stringify prints its property values because EquatableConfig.stringify defaults to true.

samples.goal: verify pkg:pypi/distro@1.9.0
contract: distro.LinuxDistribution parses standard os-release files to extract name, id, version, version_parts, major_version, minor_version, build_number, like, codename, and raw attributes

samples.goal: Enabling the serde feature on semver serializes Version and VersionReq as flat strings rather than nested structs, while bare requirement strings default to caret ranges and empty strings fail parsing
contract: assert serde serializes Version and VersionReq as strings rejecting structural map JSON

samples.goal: Configure CSV options (liberal_parsing for unescaped quotes, quote_char: nil vs empty string, skip_blanks combined with strip, quote_empty, and CRLF row_sep) to avoid MalformedCSVError, ArgumentError, and silent whitespace row parsing
contract: assert RFC 4180 strict parsing raises CSV::MalformedCSVError on unescaped internal quotes and backslash quotes unless liberal_parsing is enabled

samples.goal: verify github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn.ParseConfig in pkg:golang/github.com/jackc/pgx/v5@v5.10.0
contract: pgconn.ParseConfig parses standard PostgreSQL connection URI into Config with host, port, database, user, password, and runtime parameters

samples.goal: verify @modelcontextprotocol/sdk.LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION in pkg:npm/%40modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.30.0
contract: LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION is a string constant exported from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js with value 2025-11-25

samples.goal: Resolve BCP 47 locales containing script codes in Intl.verifiedLocale to language-region fallback instead of stripping to base language, and format TRY and GHS with official currency symbols fixed in intl 0.20.3
contract: assert Intl.verifiedLocale resolves zh-Hans-CN to zh_CN when only regional zh_CN is available

samples.goal: Stack::new takes inner before outer middleware layers, causing the second argument to execute first on incoming requests unlike tuple composition
contract: Stack::new(layer_a, layer_b).layer(base) wraps base with layer_a first and layer_b second, executing layer_b before layer_a on incoming requests

samples.goal: verify github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql.NewConfig in pkg:golang/github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql@v1.7.1
contract: mysql.NewConfig returns a non-nil *mysql.Config initialized with default collation utf8mb4_general_ci, UTC location, AllowNativePasswords true, and CheckConnLiveness true

samples.goal: Partially update nested locale configurations like formats and relativeTime with updateLocale without wiping untouched keys
contract: extend dayjs with updateLocale, localizedFormat, and relativeTime plugins

samples.goal: verify github.com/go-logfmt/logfmt.NewEncoder in pkg:golang/github.com/go-logfmt/logfmt@v0.6.0
contract: logfmt.NewEncoder creates an Encoder writing logfmt formatted records to an io.Writer

samples.goal: verify @babel/core in pkg:npm/%40babel/core@7.27.4
contract: Babel 7.27.4 parseSync represents dynamic import as a CallExpression with an Import callee by default.
